# Renesas (preview) — Altium 365 API
> Renesas-specific device models, software projects and tools. Parked; not yet organised into bounded contexts.

Concepts: [deviceModel](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/cdm/subsets/deviceModel/), [software](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/cdm/subsets/software/), [ota](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/cdm/subsets/ota/). Schema slice: [schema.graphql](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/schema.graphql) (~24371 tokens). Overview: [overview](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/overview.md).

## Entities
- [DmAddressBlock](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-address-block.md): AddressBlock — Address block with start, size, and optional registers and peripherals. Via: DmAddressSegment.blocks, DmPeripheralInstance.addressBlocks
- [DmAddressMapModel](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-address-map-model.md): AddressMap — Address map for the device including memory and peripheral regions. Via: DmFullStackDeviceModel.deviceAddressMap
- [DmAddressSegment](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-address-segment.md): AddressSegment — A contiguous region of the device's memory map. Via: DmAddressMapModel.addressSegments
- [DmAmFieldEnum](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-am-field-enum.md): FieldEnum — An enumerated value for a register field. Via: DmAmRegisterField.enums
- [DmAmMemory](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-am-memory.md): Memory — A memory entry within an address block. Via: DmAddressBlock.memories
- [DmAmRegister](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-am-register.md): Register — A hardware register within an address block. Via: DmAddressBlock.registers
- [DmAmRegisterField](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-am-register-field.md): RegisterField — A bit field within a register. Via: DmAmRegister.fields
- [DmConfigDependency](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-config-dependency.md): PortConfigurationDependency — A dependency describing how a configuration value maps to GPIO or alternate function usage. Via: DmConfigEnumValue.configDependencies
- [DmConfigEnumValue](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-config-enum-value.md): PortConfigurationEnumValue — An enumerated value for a port configuration. Via: DmPortConfiguration.enumValues
- [DmDeviceModelAsConfigured](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-device-model-as-configured.md): ConfiguredDeviceModel — A digital twin of an embedded hardware device as configured for a specific use-case. Via: dmConfiguredDeviceModel, dmConfiguredDeviceModelAllDevices, DmResolverResult.configuredModel, SftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationRevision.deviceModel
- [DmFullStackDeviceModel](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-full-stack-device-model.md): FullStackDeviceModel — A digital twin of an embedded hardware device. GRID `grid:global::device-model:fullstack-dm/{id}`. Via: dmBoardDeviceModel, dmFullStackDeviceModel, dmFullStackDeviceModelAllDevices, DmModelSupportEntry.model
- [DmPeripheral](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-peripheral.md): Peripheral — A single peripheral definition, including its instances and properties. Via: DmAddressSegment.peripherals, DmPeripheralModel.peripherals
- [DmPeripheralInstance](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-peripheral-instance.md): PeripheralInstance — A concrete instance of a peripheral (e.g., SCI0), including available modes. Via: DmAddressBlock.peripheralInstance, DmPeripheral.peripheralInstances, DmPeripheralChanges.addedInstances, …
- [DmPeripheralMode](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-peripheral-mode.md): PeripheralMode — A specific mode that a peripheral instance can fulfill,. Via: DmPeripheralInstance.modes
- [DmPin](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-pin.md): Pin — A physical pin on the device. Via: DmPort.pin
- [DmPort](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-port.md): Port — A physical port on the device, with its functions, configurations, and connections. Via: DmModePinConfig.port, DmPortModel.ports
- [DmPortConfiguration](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-port-configuration.md): PortConfiguration — A specific configuration for a port. Via: DmPort.configurations
- [DmPortConnection](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-port-connection.md): PortConnection — A connection from this port to another component or signal. Via: DmPort.connections
- [DmPortFunction](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/dm-port-function.md): PortFunction — A specific function that a port can perform. Via: DmPort.functions
- [SftDevCfgDeviceConfiguration](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/sft-dev-cfg-device-configuration.md): Device Configuration — The configuration of a device (e.g. an MCU placed as a hardware component in an ESD document), covering its ports, package information, peripherals and pin assignments. GRID `grid:workspace:{workspace-id}:software:device-configuration/{id}`. Via: sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationById, sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationsByIds, sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurations, SftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationRevision.deviceConfiguration, SftSoftwareProject.deviceConfiguration
- [SftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationRevision](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/sft-dev-cfg-device-configuration-revision.md): Device Configuration Revision. GRID `grid:workspace:{workspace-id}:software:device-configuration-revision/{id}`. Via: sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationRevisionById, sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationRevisionsByIds, sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationRevisionsByDeviceConfigurationId, SftDevCfgDeviceConfiguration.latestRevision, SftDevCfgDeviceConfiguration.revisions
- [SftSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/types/objects/sft-software-project.md): Software Project — The software part of a Renesas 365 solution, developed in the built-in Web IDE (based on the Theia framework) or in e² studio; it can also be created with an external repository type. GRID `grid:workspace:{workspace-id}:software:software-project/{id}`. Via: sftSoftwareProjectById, sftSoftwareProjectsByIds, sftSoftwareProjects, SftDevCfgDeviceConfiguration.softwareProject, SolSolution.softwareProjects

## Entry points
- [rsaMotorStudioEasyModeConfigById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-easy-mode-config-by-id.md): Get an easymode config by id. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioProjectById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-project-by-id.md): Retrieves a MotorStudioProject [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioProjectsByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-projects-by-ids.md): Gets motor studio projects by IDs. [EXPERIMENTAL]

- [rsaMotorStudioScopeConfigById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-scope-config-by-id.md): Get a scope configuration by id. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioTuningById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-tuning-by-id.md): Get a tuning by id. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioTuningRevisionById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-tuning-revision-by-id.md): Get a tuning revision by id. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioVariableSetById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-variable-set-by-id.md): Get a variable set by id. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [sftAIModelById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-aimodel-by-id.md): Gets AI model by identifier.
- [sftAIModelsByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-aimodels-by-ids.md): Gets AI models by identifiers.
- [sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-dev-cfg-device-configuration-by-id.md): Gets device configuration by ID.
- [sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationRevisionById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-dev-cfg-device-configuration-revision-by-id.md): Gets device configuration revision by ID.
- [sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationRevisionsByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-dev-cfg-device-configuration-revisions-by-ids.md): Gets device configuration revisions by IDs.
- [sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationsByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-dev-cfg-device-configurations-by-ids.md): Gets device configurations by IDs.
- [sftSimSimulationById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-sim-simulation-by-id.md): Gets simulation by identifier.
- [sftSimSimulationsByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-sim-simulations-by-ids.md): Gets simulations by identifiers.
- [sftSoftwareProjectById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-software-project-by-id.md): Gets software project by ID.
- [sftSoftwareProjectsByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-software-projects-by-ids.md): Gets software projects by IDs.
- [dmConfiguredDeviceModelAllDevices](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/dm-configured-device-model-all-devices.md) (list) [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [dmFullStackDeviceModelAllDevices](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/dm-full-stack-device-model-all-devices.md) (list) [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurationRevisionsByDeviceConfigurationId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-dev-cfg-device-configuration-revisions-by-device-configuration-id.md) (list): Gets revisions of given device configuration.
- [sftDevCfgDeviceConfigurations](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-dev-cfg-device-configurations.md) (list): Gets all available device configurations.
- [sftSoftwareProjects](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-software-projects.md) (list): Gets all available software projects.

## Queries
- [dmBoardDeviceModel](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/dm-board-device-model.md): A board model (an MCU as soldered onto a specific eval kit) by board name. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [dmConfiguredDeviceModel](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/dm-configured-device-model.md) [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [dmDeviceFamilies](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/dm-device-families.md): Returns the supported device families (backend-owned), ordered by priority, each with a live total device count. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [dmFamilyPartModel](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/dm-family-part-model.md) [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [dmFullStackDeviceModel](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/dm-full-stack-device-model.md) [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [dmFullStackDeviceModelReport](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/dm-full-stack-device-model-report.md) [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [dmFullStackDeviceModelReportAllDevices](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/dm-full-stack-device-model-report-all-devices.md) [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [dmInterfaceSupportSummary](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/dm-interface-support-summary.md): Returns a summary of supported interfaces across all devices, including instance counts and device support details. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [dmInterfaceTypeModels](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/dm-interface-type-models.md): Returns the unified dictionary of supported interface (port) types, including display metadata and which are user-selectable. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioEasyModeConfigs](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-easy-mode-configs.md): List existing easymode configs for a project. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioProjects](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-projects.md): Retrieves collection of MotorStudioProject [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioScopeCaptures](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-scope-captures.md): List scope captures for a project. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioScopeConfigs](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-scope-configs.md): List scope configurations for a project. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioTuningRevisionsByTuningId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-tuning-revisions-by-tuning-id.md): List tuning revisions for a tuning. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioTunings](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-tunings.md): List tunings. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [rsaMotorStudioVariableSets](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/rsa-motor-studio-variable-sets.md): List variable sets for a project. [EXPERIMENTAL]
- [sftAIModels](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-aimodels.md): Gets all available AI models.
- [sftSimSimulations](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/queries/sft-sim-simulations.md): Gets all available simulations.

- [sftDevCfgLinkDeviceConfigurationToSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-dev-cfg-link-device-configuration-to-software-project.md): Creates a link between device configuration and software project.
- [sftDevCfgUnlinkDeviceConfigurationFromSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-dev-cfg-unlink-device-configuration-from-software-project.md): Removes a link between device configuration and software project.
- [sftDevCfgUnlinkDeviceConfigurationRevisionFromHardwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-dev-cfg-unlink-device-configuration-revision-from-hardware-project.md): Removes an existing link between device configuration revision and hardware project.
- [sftSimSimulationCreate](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-sim-simulation-create.md): Creates new simulation.
- [sftSimSimulationCreateCustomProperties](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-sim-simulation-create-custom-properties.md): Creates the simulation custom properties.
- [sftSimSimulationDelete](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-sim-simulation-delete.md): Deletes simulation by identifier.
- [sftSimSimulationDeleteCustomProperties](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-sim-simulation-delete-custom-properties.md): Delete the simulation custom properties.
- [sftSimSimulationUpdate](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-sim-simulation-update.md): Updates the simulation.
- [sftSimSimulationUpdateCustomProperties](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-sim-simulation-update-custom-properties.md): Updates the simulation custom properties.
- [sftSoftwareCreateProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-software-create-project.md): Creates new Sofware Project.
- [sftSoftwareCreateProjectCustomProperties](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-software-create-project-custom-properties.md): Creates the Software Project custom properties.
- [sftSoftwareDeleteProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-software-delete-project.md): Deletes Software Project by ID.
- [sftSoftwareDeleteProjectCustomProperties](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-software-delete-project-custom-properties.md): Delete the Software Project custom properties.
- [sftSoftwareUpdateProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-software-update-project.md): Updates the Software Project.
- [sftSoftwareUpdateProjectConfiguration](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-software-update-project-configuration.md): Updates the Software Project configuration.
- [sftSoftwareUpdateProjectCustomProperties](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-software-update-project-custom-properties.md): Updates the Software Project custom properties.
- [sftSoftwareUpdateProjectFirmware](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/renesas-preview/operations/mutations/sft-software-update-project-firmware.md): Updates the Software Project firmware.
